narrative.intro: Medline Industries is the federal contractor of record with $806M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Medline Industries won 678 awards this fiscal year to date, with an average award size of $1.2M and obligations that are up 39.2% year over year. The Department of Veterans Affairs is the dominant buyer, accounting for $763M of obligations in FY2026 to date. Medical, Dental, and Hospital Equipment and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers is the largest NAICS market for Medline Industries at $769M in FY2026 to date, followed by Surgical and Medical Instrument Manufacturing at $35.8M. Historical obligations show a multiyear increase: FY21 $262M, FY22 $281M, FY23 $337M, FY24 $370M, FY25 $579M, and FY26 $806M. The dataset notes that totals are contract obligations except where tables list award-value figures as total contract values, and that current-year totals are partial fiscal year to date.

sections.heading: Who are Medline Industries' top federal buyers?
sections.body: The Department of Veterans Affairs obligated $763M to Medline Industries in FY2026 to date. The Department of Health and Human Services obligated $32M and the Department of Justice obligated $10M. Smaller obligations came from the Department of the Treasury ($295K), the Department of the Interior ($109K), and the Department of Defense ($63.1K).

sections.heading: What markets and products drive Medline Industries' federal business?
sections.body: Medical, Dental, and Hospital Equipment and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers is the largest market at $769M in FY2026 to date. Surgical and Medical Instrument Manufacturing is the next largest market at $35.8M. Other markets include Surgical Appliance and Supplies Manufacturing at $916K and In-Vitro Diagnostic Substance Manufacturing at $173K.

faq.q: How much does Medline Industries make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Medline Industries has $806M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Medline Industries received 678 awards this fiscal year to date, with an average award size of $1.2M and obligations up 39.2% year over year.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Medline Industries?
faq.a: The Department of Veterans Affairs is the largest buyer, having obligated $763M to Medline Industries in FY2026 to date. Other buyers include the Department of Health and Human Services ($32M), the Department of Justice ($10M), the Department of the Treasury ($295K), the Department of the Interior ($109K), and the Department of Defense ($63.1K).

faq.q: What does Medline Industries sell to the government?
faq.a: Medline Industries sells medical and surgical supplies and equipment, primarily through the Medical, Dental, and Hospital Equipment and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers market, which accounted for $769M in FY2026 to date. Additional product flows are captured under Surgical and Medical Instrument Manufacturing ($35.8M), Surgical Appliance and Supplies Manufacturing ($916K), and In-Vitro Diagnostic Substance Manufacturing ($173K).
